plugins.description: MyBusiness CRM implementation toolkit: a built-in connection to your own CRM (Application Id + an API key you generate yourself) + the product knowledge base + no-code implementation skills - entities, pages, table views, dashboards, reports, triggers, form rules, users and permissions, terminology, price quotes, data import, web2lead, SLA, CSAT surveys and fit-gap analysis. Hebrew-first. Also packaged as an Agent Plugins 1.0 bundle for non-Claude agents.
